scientific_question: Does the already-opened four-increment straight-CGLS span contain a candidate that passes the complete frozen v40 field, gradient, and curved-observation gate when truth is allowed only for a post-open feasibility oracle?

frozen_inputs.pair_role: the independently validated v40.2 BLASTNet proxy bundle
frozen_inputs.v40_result_role: the independently validated v40.2 frozen external result
frozen_inputs.v41_result_role: the independently validated v41 observation-only four-increment diagnosis

basis.directions: the four sequential straight-ray CGLS increments reconstructed from the frozen curved-observation residual

truth_constraints.field_limit: minimum of 1.01 times Direct-K4 field relative-L2 and Zero field relative-L2
truth_constraints.gradient_limit: minimum of 1.01 times Direct-K4 gradient relative-L2 and Zero gradient relative-L2
truth_constraints.constraint_functions: squared relative-L2 quadratic forms with exact analytic Jacobians

optimizer.objective_gradient: exact PyTorch gradient through the frozen curved forward

candidate_bank.retention_rule: union of the best eight candidates by field, gradient, and observation relative-L2, followed by deterministic lexicographic truncation

per_snapshot: all field, gradient, and observation metrics are at most 1.01 times Direct-K4
all field, gradient, and observation metrics are no worse than Zero
observation is no worse than Direct-K3 plus 1e-12
candidate is not Pareto dominated by Direct-K3
complete_frozen_v40_gate.aggregate: the median candidate field, gradient, and observation metrics are each no worse than the corresponding Direct-K4 medians
complete_frozen_v40_gate.joint_selection: enumerate the retained per-snapshot candidate-bank Cartesian product and select a complete-gate passing tuple lexicographically by aggregate observation median, mean observation, aggregate gradient median, and aggregate field median

decision_rule.headroom_present: all four snapshots have retained per-snapshot passing candidates and one retained joint tuple passes the complete frozen v40 gate in both the formal and independent implementations
decision_rule.search_bounded_negative: no complete-gate tuple is found, all required searches meet the frozen execution and validation checks, and the result is stated only as no passing candidate found under the preregistered search
decision_rule.fragile_exact_pass: an exact complete-gate tuple whose smallest margin to a 1.01 Direct-K4 gate is below 1e-3 is reported as fragile and does not authorize selector training
decision_rule.inconclusive: input seals, basis parity, finite checks, minimum search coverage, budget, unreported candidate-bank truncation, optimizer replay, candidate-bank replay, or independent agreement fail
